BiblicalUsage: Putiel was an Israelite, the father-in-law of Eleazar, Aaron's son. Eleazar Aaron's son took him one of the daughters of Putiel to wife, and she bare him Phinehas.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Putiel matters because of his daughter: her marriage to Eleazar joined the priestly line to his house, and her son Phinehas carried the priesthood forward.
